1444    def setup_optimization(
1445        self, 
1446        optimization_config_list:List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str,
1447        structure_list:List[BrachyStructure],
1448        add_hotspots_to_phantom:bool=False,
1449        one_hotspot_structure:bool=True
1450        ):
1451        r"""
1452        ### Purpose:
1453        - Given the optimization config list either as a list or in a json file, put each
1454        optimization config inside the BrachyStructures. Also, create the hotspot estimator
1455        structure if needed.
1456        """
1457        self._reset_optimization()
1458        if isinstance(optimization_config_list, (Path, str)):
1459            optimization_config_list = Path(optimization_config_list).resolve()
1460            if str(optimization_config_list).endswith(".json"):
1461                with open(optimization_config_list, "r") as json_file:
1462                    optimization_config_list = json.load(json_file)
1463            else:
1464                raise ValueError("optimization_config_list can be a json file or a list of Optimization_Config objects")
1465        target_structure_names = [
1466            structure.name.lower() for structure in self.structure_list
1467            if structure.is_target
1468            ]
1469        for config in optimization_config_list:
1470            if config.penalty_weight_hotspot != 0:
1471                if config.structure_name.lower() not in target_structure_names:
1472                    raise ValueError(
1473                        "penalty_weight_hotspot can only be set for PTV or CTV structures"
1474                    )
1475                self._create_hotspot_structures(
1476                    target_optim_config=config,
1477                    add_hotspots_to_phantom=add_hotspots_to_phantom,
1478                    one_hotspot_structure=one_hotspot_structure)
1479            for struc in structure_list:
1480                if config.structure_name.lower() == struc.name.lower():
1481                    assert config.is_target == struc.is_target, f"The target structure in plan and optimization \
1482config do not match for structure {struc.name}"
1483                    struc.set_optimization_config(config)
1484                    break
1485
1486    def _create_hotspot_structures(
1487        self,
1488        target_optim_config: Optimization_Config,
1489        add_hotspots_to_phantom:bool=False,
1490        one_hotspot_structure:bool=True
1491        ):
1492        r"""
1493        ### Purpose:
1494        - to create structures where hotspots are likely to occur inside the ptv or ctv.
1495        These structures are created as spheres with radius of dwell step size centered in 
1496        between two dwell positions that are within a step size distance from each other.
1497        There could be only one hotspot structure per each dwell pair.
1498        ### Inputs:
1499        - self := the BrachyPlan object
1500        - config := the optimization config object that contains the parameters for the hotspot structure
1501        ### Outputs:
1502        - None := hot spot structures are appended to the self.structure_list
1503        """
1504        self.update_plan_from_catheter_table()
1505        step_size = self.catheter_table.step_size
1506        # identify unique dwell pairs that are withi n the step size distance
1507        dwell_pairs = []
1508        def distance(pos1, pos2):
1509            return np.linalg.norm(pos1 - pos2)
1510        def center(pos1, pos2):
1511            return (pos1 + pos2) / 2
1512
1513        for i in range(len(self.dwell_coordinates)):
1514            for j in range(i + 1, len(self.dwell_coordinates)):
1515                current_distance = distance(
1516                    np.array(self.dwell_coordinates[i]["position"]),
1517                    np.array(self.dwell_coordinates[j]["position"])) 
1518                if current_distance <= step_size:
1519                    dwell_pairs.append(
1520                        {
1521                            "dwell_pair": (
1522                                {
1523                                    "catheter":self.dwell_coordinates[i]["catheter_index"]+1,
1524                                    "dwell": self.dwell_coordinates[i]["dwell_index"]+1
1525                                },
1526                                {
1527                                    "catheter":self.dwell_coordinates[j]["catheter_index"]+1,
1528                                    "dwell": self.dwell_coordinates[j]["dwell_index"]+1
1529                                }),
1530                            "center": center(
1531                                np.array(self.dwell_coordinates[i]["position"]),
1532                                np.array(self.dwell_coordinates[j]["position"])
1533                            ),
1534                            "radius": step_size,
1535                            "distance": current_distance,
1536                            "inter-catheter": True if (
1537                                self.dwell_coordinates[i]["catheter_index"] 
1538                                != self.dwell_coordinates[j]["catheter_index"]
1539                                ) else False
1540                        }
1541                    )
1542        # create hotspot structures masks for each dwell pair
1543        hotspot_mask_list = []
1544        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
1545            futures = {
1546                executor.submit(
1547                    _gen_hotspot_mask,
1548                    dwell_pair,
1549                    self.phantom.image_obj.gridSize,
1550                    self.phantom.image_obj.origin,
1551                    self.phantom.image_obj.spacing,
1552                ): dwell_pair for dwell_pair in dwell_pairs
1553            }
1554            for action in tqdm(
1555                as_completed(futures),
1556                desc="Generating hotspot estimator volumes",
1557                total=len(dwell_pairs)
1558            ):
1559                try:
1560                    hotspot_mask_list.append(action.result())
1561                except:
1562                    raise ValueError("failed building hotspot volumes")
1563                    
1564        if one_hotspot_structure:
1565            mask_union = np.zeros_like(
1566                hotspot_mask_list[0].mask.imageArray, dtype=bool
1567            )
1568            for mask in hotspot_mask_list:
1569                mask_union = np.logical_or(mask_union, mask.mask.imageArray)
1570
1571            hotspot_config = Optimization_Config(
1572                structure_name="hotspot_estimator_combined",
1573                is_target=False,
1574                spacing_mm=target_optim_config.spacing_mm,
1575                dose_voxel_goal=target_optim_config.dose_voxel_goal*target_optim_config.hotspot_threshold,
1576                penalty_weight_linear=target_optim_config.penalty_weight_hotspot
1577            )
1578            hotspot_mask_list = [
1579                BrachyStructure(
1580                    name="hotspot_estimator_combined",
1581                    mask=ROIMask(
1582                        name="hotspot_estimator_combined",
1583                        imageArray=mask_union,
1584                        origin=self.phantom.image_obj.origin,
1585                        spacing=self.phantom.image_obj.spacing,
1586                    ),
1587                    is_target=False,
1588                    in_dvh=False,
1589                    optimization_config=hotspot_config
1590                )
1591            ]
1592
1593        for mask in hotspot_mask_list:
1594            self.structure_list.append(mask)
1595            if add_hotspots_to_phantom:
1596                self.phantom.set_structure_set(
1597                    mask_dict={mask.name: mask.mask},
1598                    mask_colors={mask.name:[251, 159, 255]}
1599                    )
1600
1601    def _reset_optimization(self):
1602        r"""
1603        ### Purpose:
1604        - to reset the optimization configurations of all structures in the plan.
1605        ### Inputs:
1606        - self := the BrachyPlan object
1607        ### Outputs:
1608        - None := optimization_config attribute of all structures in the plan is set to None
1609        """
1610        for structure in self.structure_list:
1611            if structure.name.startswith("hotspot_estimator_"):
1612                self.structure_list.remove(structure)
1613                self.phantom.remove_structure(structure.name)
1614                continue
1615            structure.optimization_config = None
1616
1617    def get_dose_rate_matrices_for_catheter(
1618        self,
1619        catheter_index: int
1620    ) -> Dict[str, BrachyDose]:
1621        r"""
1622        ### Purpose:
1623        - to get the dose rate matrices for all dwell positions in a given catheter.
1624        this function assumes that dose rate dictionary matches the index+1 convension.
1625        ### Inputs:
1626        - catheter_index := the index of the catheter in the catheter table
1627        ### Outputs:
1628        - Dict[BrachyDose]: A dictionary containing the dose rates for the speicific catheter.
1629        the keys are in the format catheter_{index+1}_dwell_{index+1}
1630        """
1631        catheter = self.catheter_table[catheter_index]
1632        dose_rates_catheter = defaultdict(BrachyDose)
1633        for dwell in catheter:
1634            dose_rates_catheter[
1635                f"catheter_{catheter.name_id}_dwell_{dwell.name_id}"
1636                ] = dwell.dose_rate
1637        return dose_rates_catheter

Purpose:

  • This class holds the information regarding the brachytherapy treatment plan as well as all the functions to support the necessary plan operations.

Attributes:

Geometry and Structure Attributes:

  • phantom (BrachyPhantom): A BrachyPhantom object containing the patient geometry and structures.
  • structure_list (List[BrachyStructure]): A list of BrachyStructure objects containing the patient structures.
  • body_contour (ROIContour): The body contour of the patient.
  • phantom_origin (list): The origin of the phantom in the patient coordinate system.
  • organ_bounds (list): Min and max coordinates of the patient organs on each axis.
  • dvh_metric_goals (dict): Dictionary containing the DVH metric goals for the plan.
  • dvh_metrics_observed (dict): Dictionary containing the observed DVH metrics for the plan.
  • prescription_dose (float): The dose prescribed to the target volume.

Catheter and Dwell Position Attributes:

  • catheter_table (CatheterTable): A catheter table object containing the catheter information.
  • num_catheters (int): The number of catheters in the plan.
  • catheter_numbers (list): The catheter ID numbers for each catheter in the catheter table.
  • num_dwells (int): The total number of dwell positions along all catheters in the plan.
  • dwell_numbers (list): The dwell number ID of each dwell position in the plan.
  • dwell_times (List[float]): The dwell time for each dwell position in the plan.
  • dwell_coordinates (List[list]): The coordinates of each dwell position in patient coordinates.

Applicator Attributes:

  • applicator_list (List[BrachyApplicator]): The list of all applicators in the plan.
  • applicator_rotation_axis (np.array): The rotation axis of applicators (default: [0, 0, 1]).
  • applicator_rotation_origin (np.array): The rotation origin of applicators (default: [0, 0, 0]).

Dose Attributes:

  • dose_rate_dict (defaultdict[BrachyDose]): Dictionary holding 3D dose rate maps for each dwell position.
  • combined_dose (BrachyDose): Sum of the dose rate maps weighted by the dwell times.

Simulation and Optimization Attributes:

  • simulation_setup (BrachySimulation): A simulation setup object containing source info and simulation parameters.
  • optimization_config_list (List[Optimization_Config]): List of optimization configurations for the plan.
BrachyPlan( phantom: Union[pathlib._local.Path, brachyutils.geometry.BrachyPhantom, dict] = None, prescription_dose: float = None, strict_name_match: bool = True, catheter_table: Union[pathlib._local.Path, brachyutils.geometry.catheter_utils.catheter_table.CatheterTable, str] = None, applicator_pth_list: Union[pathlib._local.Path, str, list] = None, combined_dose: Union[pathlib._local.Path, str, brachyutils.dose.BrachyDose] = None, dir_dose_rate: pathlib._local.Path = None, simulation_setup: dict | pathlib._local.Path | str = None, optimization_config_list: Union[List[brachyutils.planning.optimization.optim_utils.Optimization_Config], pathlib._local.Path, str] = None, **kwargs) 
209    def __init__(
210        self,
211        #### for geometry definition:
212        phantom: Union[Path, BrachyPhantom, dict] = None,
213        #### for structure creation:
214        prescription_dose: float = None,
215        strict_name_match: bool = True,
216        #### for loading catheter table and/or applicators:
217        catheter_table: Union[Path, CatheterTable, str] = None,
218        applicator_pth_list: Union[Path, str, list] = None,
219        #### for loading dose or uncertainty:
220        combined_dose: Union[Path, str, BrachyDose] = None,
221        dir_dose_rate: Path = None,
222        #### for simulation setup:
223        simulation_setup: dict | Path | str = None,
224        #### for optimization setup:
225        optimization_config_list:  List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str = None,
226        **kwargs
227    ):
228        r"""
229        ### Purpose:
230        - To initialize the BrachyPlan object.
231
232        ### Inputs:
233        #### For geometry definition:
234        - phantom: Path|BrachyPhantom|dict := the phantom object, the path to the phantom directory,
235        or a dictionary containing the paths. A phantom object can include structures as well. See load_phantom() for more info.
236
237        #### For Structure optimization and dosimetry
238        - prescription_dose: float = None := The dose that is prescribed to the target volume. This is used to calculate the DVH metrics. 
239
240        #### for loading catheter table and applicators:
241        - catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a json file containing the information of the catheter table.
242        - applicator_pth_list := The list of applicator paths or the path to the json file containing the list. see load_applicator_list() for more info.
243
244        #### for loading dose rates or uncertainty maps per dwell position:
245        - combined_dose: Path|BrachyDose := the path to the combined dose file or a BrachyDose object.
246        - dir_dose_rate:str := path to the directory containing the dose rate files for a patient.
247
248        #### for simulation setup:
249        - simulation_setup = None := dictionary containing the simulation setup,
250        - load_uncertainty:bool := If True, the uncertainties of the dose rates are also loaded. 
251        - multi_processing:bool :=  If True, 16 threads are used to load the dose rates simulatenously.
252        - combined_dose_only:bool := If True, all the dose rates will be removed from memory after 
253        combined dose is calculated.
254        - dose_dtype:np.float32 := The floating point type to store the dose rates. 
255
256        #### Keywords Arguments:
257        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True := if True, will only load the dwell positions that
258        had non-zero dwell times in the DICOM plan file. If False, will load all the dwell positions
259        from the digitization points.
260        - dwells_near_ptv: bool = True := if True, will remove the dwell positions that are outside PTV
261        with a margine of 10 mm.
262        - add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False := if True, will add hotspot structures to the phantom.
263        this is good for debugging, but slows down the plan creation process.
264        - one_hotspot_structure: bool: = True := if False, will create separate hotspot structures
265        - applicator_format:str = "RapidBrachy" := the format of the applicator list 
266        (default is "RapidBrachy"). See load_applicator_list() for more info. 
267        - load_uncertainty: bool := If true, it will the uncertainty of the dose rates as well.
268        - dvh_metric_goals: List[str] | Dict[str, float] | Path | str := A list of all DVH metric
269        names or the dictionary containing the DVH metric names and their goals or the path to its
270        json file. Look at set_dvh_metric_goals for guideline on the names of the DVH metrics.
271        The phantom should be loaded with structures for the Brachy stuctures to be created.
272
273        ### Outputs:
274            - Void := will initialize the BrachyPlan object
275        """
276        # declare the attributes
277        # patient origin is used as a reference point for the catheter table,
278        # the dwell coordinates, image origin, egsphant, and the dose objects.
279
280        # phantom and geometry attributes
281        self.phantom: BrachyPhantom = None
282        self.dvh_metric_goals: dict = None
283        self.structure_list: List[BrachyStructure] = []
284        self.body_contour: ROIContour = None
285        self.phantom_origin: list = None  # np.array([0, 0, 0])  # x,y,z
286        self.organ_bounds: list = None
287
288        # catheter table attributes
289        self.catheter_table: CatheterTable = None
290        self.num_catheters: int = None
291        self.catheter_numbers:list = np.array([], dtype=int)  # shape: (num_catheters, 1)
292        self.num_dwells: int = None
293        self.dwell_numbers: list = np.array([], dtype=int)  # shape: (num_dwells, 1)
294        self.dwell_times: List[float] = np.array([], dtype=np.float32)  # shape: (num_dwells, 1)
295        self.dwell_coordinates: List[list] = []  # shape: (num_dwells, 3)
296
297        # applicator attributes
298        self.applicator_list: List[BrachyApplicator] = []
299        # XXX: figure out if the two below are dwell or applicator attributes?
300        # they are dwell attributes that are impacted by applicator rotation. for now, leave them be.
301        self.applicator_rotation_axis: np.array = np.array([0, 0, 1])  # x,y,z
302        self.applicator_rotation_origin: float = np.array([0, 0, 0])  # x,y,z
303
304        # dose attributes
305
306        # simulation attributes
307        self.simulation_setup: BrachySimulation = None
308
309        ## fill the attributes depending on the inputs to the constructor
310        # set the dvh metric goals if provided
311        self.prescription_dose = prescription_dose
312        # load the dicom plan if the path is provided
313        if phantom is not None:
314            if isinstance(phantom, BrachyPhantom):
315                self.phantom = phantom
316            elif (
317                isinstance(phantom, Path)
318                or isinstance(phantom, str)
319                or isinstance(phantom, dict)
320            ):
321                self.load_phantom(phantom)
322            else:
323                raise ValueError("phantom should be a BrachyPhantom object or a path")
324        # create structures based on the phantom structures and DVH metric goals
325        if self.phantom is not None:
326            if self.phantom.structure_set is not None:
327                self.set_brachy_structure_list(
328                    phantom=self.phantom,
329                )
330
331        if kwargs.get("dvh_metric_goals", None) is not None:
332            dvh_metric_goals = kwargs.get("dvh_metric_goals")
333            if self.prescription_dose is None:
334                raise ValueError("prescription dose is not provided. Please provide it.")
335            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, str) or isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, Path):
336                dvh_metric_goals = Path(dvh_metric_goals)
337                with open(dvh_metric_goals, "r") as json_file:
338                    dvh_metric_goals = json.load(json_file)
339            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, list):
340                self.set_dvh_metric_goals(
341                    dvh_metric_names=dvh_metric_goals,
342                    strict_name_match=strict_name_match)
343            elif isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, dict):
344                self.set_dvh_metric_goals(
345                    dvh_metric_goals=dvh_metric_goals,
346                    strict_name_match=strict_name_match)
347
348        # load the catheter table if the path is provided
349        if catheter_table is not None:
350            self.set_catheter_table(
351                catheter_table=catheter_table,
352                from_delivered_dwellpositions=kwargs.get("from_delivered_dwellpositions", False),
353                dwells_near_ptv=kwargs.get("dwells_near_ptv", True),
354                )
355        # load the dose rate dict if the path is provided
356        if dir_dose_rate is not None and combined_dose is None:
357            self.catheter_table.load_dose_rates(
358                dir_dose_rate=dir_dose_rate,
359                load_uncertainty=kwargs.get("load_uncertainty", False),
360                multi_processing=kwargs.get("multi_processing", True),
361                combined_dose_only=kwargs.get("combined_dose_only", False),
362                dose_dtype=kwargs.get("dose_dtype", np.float32),
363                )
364        elif dir_dose_rate is None and combined_dose is not None:
365            self.catheter_table.set_combined_dose(combined_dose)
366        elif dir_dose_rate is not None and combined_dose is not None:
367            raise ValueError(
368                "invalid input. Please provide either dir_dose_rate or combined_dose but not both"
369            )
370        else:
371            warnings.warn("no dose rate is loaded", stacklevel=2)
372
373        # # load the simulation setup if the dictionary is provided
374        if simulation_setup is not None:
375            if isinstance(simulation_setup, dict):
376                self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
377                    **simulation_setup
378                )
379            elif isinstance(simulation_setup, Path) or isinstance(
380                simulation_setup, str
381            ):
382                # if json file, load the entire simulation dict from json file
383                if str(simulation_setup).endswith(".json"):
384                   self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
385                    pth_simulation_setup=simulation_setup
386                )
387                # if dicom plan file, load the source from the dicom file
388                # and assuming the catheter table is loaded from the same dicom file,
389                # provide the total time from the catheter table
390                elif str(simulation_setup).endswith(".dcm"):
391                    self.simulation_setup = BrachySimulation(
392                        brachy_source=simulation_setup,
393                        total_time=np.sum(self.dwell_times))
394
395        # load the applicator list if the path is provided
396        if applicator_pth_list is not None and applicator_format is not None:
397            self.load_applicator_list(
398                applicator_pth_list, kwargs.get("applicator_format", "RapidBrachy"))
399
400        # # setup optimization
401        if optimization_config_list is not None:
402            self.optimization_config_list = optimization_config_list
403            self.setup_optimization(
404                self.optimization_config_list,
405                self.structure_list,
406                add_hotspots_to_phantom=kwargs.get("add_hotspots_to_phantom", False),
407                one_hotspot_structure=kwargs.get("one_hotspot_structure", True),
408            )

Purpose:

  • To initialize the BrachyPlan object.

Inputs:

For geometry definition:

  • phantom: Path|BrachyPhantom|dict := the phantom object, the path to the phantom directory, or a dictionary containing the paths. A phantom object can include structures as well. See load_phantom() for more info.

For Structure optimization and dosimetry

  • prescription_dose: float = None := The dose that is prescribed to the target volume. This is used to calculate the DVH metrics.

for loading catheter table and applicators:

  • catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a json file containing the information of the catheter table.
  • applicator_pth_list := The list of applicator paths or the path to the json file containing the list. see load_applicator_list() for more info.

for loading dose rates or uncertainty maps per dwell position:

  • combined_dose: Path|BrachyDose := the path to the combined dose file or a BrachyDose object.
  • dir_dose_rate:str := path to the directory containing the dose rate files for a patient.

for simulation setup:

  • simulation_setup = None := dictionary containing the simulation setup,
  • load_uncertainty:bool := If True, the uncertainties of the dose rates are also loaded.
  • multi_processing:bool := If True, 16 threads are used to load the dose rates simulatenously.
  • combined_dose_only:bool := If True, all the dose rates will be removed from memory after combined dose is calculated.
  • dose_dtype:np.float32 := The floating point type to store the dose rates.

Keywords Arguments:

  • from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True := if True, will only load the dwell positions that had non-zero dwell times in the DICOM plan file. If False, will load all the dwell positions from the digitization points.
  • dwells_near_ptv: bool = True := if True, will remove the dwell positions that are outside PTV with a margine of 10 mm.
  • add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False := if True, will add hotspot structures to the phantom. this is good for debugging, but slows down the plan creation process.
  • one_hotspot_structure: bool: = True := if False, will create separate hotspot structures
  • applicator_format:str = "RapidBrachy" := the format of the applicator list (default is "RapidBrachy"). See load_applicator_list() for more info.
  • load_uncertainty: bool := If true, it will the uncertainty of the dose rates as well.
  • dvh_metric_goals: List[str] | Dict[str, float] | Path | str := A list of all DVH metric names or the dictionary containing the DVH metric names and their goals or the path to its json file. Look at set_dvh_metric_goals for guideline on the names of the DVH metrics. The phantom should be loaded with structures for the Brachy stuctures to be created.

Outputs:

- Void := will initialize the BrachyPlan object

dvh_metric_goals: dict
structure_list: List[BrachyStructure]
body_contour: opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour
phantom_origin: list

num_catheters: int
catheter_numbers: list
num_dwells: int
dwell_numbers: list
dwell_times: List[float]
dwell_coordinates: List[list]
applicator_list: List[brachyutils.geometry.BrachyApplicator]
applicator_rotation_axis: <built-in function array>

Wrap a classmethod, staticmethod, property or unbound function and act as a descriptor that allows us to detect decorated items from the class' attributes.

This class' __get__ returns the wrapped item's __get__ result, which makes it transparent for classmethods and staticmethods.

Attributes: wrapped: The decorator that has to be wrapped. decorator_info: The decorator info. shim: A wrapper function to wrap V1 style function.

def load_phantom(self, pth_phantom: Union[pathlib._local.Path, dict]): 
414    def load_phantom(self, pth_phantom: Union[Path, dict]):
415        r"""
416        ### Purpose:
417        - To load phantom from file path into Brachy Plan. Not that if a directory is provided,
418        it should have only one phantom file.
419        ### Inputs:
420        - pth_phantom:str := The phantom path could be a directory of DICOM files
421        or a directory of NRRD files. In addition, it could be the path to a json
422        file containing paths to specific phantom files. Look at the inputs of BrachPhantom
423        for more information on the expected keys of the json file.
424        ### Outputs:
425        - Void := will update the BrachyPlan.phantom attribute
426        """
427        os.path.exists(pth_phantom), f"phantom path does not exist: {pth_phantom}"
428        # initialize the inputs to the BrachyPhantom object
429        dir_dicom = None
430        pth_phantom_file = None
431        pth_structures_file = None
432        pth_egsphant_file = None
433        # if the paths are provided as a dictionary
434        if isinstance(pth_phantom, dict):
435            phantom_config = pth_phantom
436            for key in phantom_config:
437                if key == "dir_dicom":
438                    dir_dicom = phantom_config.get(key)
439                elif key == "pth_phantom_file":
440                    pth_phantom_file = phantom_config.get(key)
441                elif key == "pth_structures_file":
442                    pth_structures_file = phantom_config.get(key)
443                elif key == "pth_egsphant_file":
444                    pth_egsphant_file = phantom_config.get(key)
445        # check if the pth_phantom is a directory or a json file
446        elif os.path.isdir(pth_phantom):
447            print("loading phantom from directory")
448            # check if the directory contains dicom files or nrrd files
449            file_list = glob(os.path.join(pth_phantom, "*.dcm"))
450            if len(file_list) > 0:
451                dir_dicom = pth_phantom
452                pth_structures_file = list(filter(lambda x: "RS" in x, file_list))[0]
453            else:
454                file_list = glob(os.path.join(pth_phantom, "*.nrrd"))
455                if len(file_list) > 0:
456                    for file_name in file_list:
457                        if file_name.endswith(".seg.nrrd"):
458                            pth_structures_file = file_name
459                        elif file_name.endswith(".egsphant.nrrd"):
460                            pth_egsphant_file = file_name
461                        elif file_name.endswith(".nrrd"):
462                            pth_phantom_file = file_name
463                    if pth_egsphant_file is None:
464                        pth_egsphant_file = glob(
465                            os.path.join(pth_phantom, "ct.egsphant.nrrd")
466                        )
467                        if len(pth_egsphant_file) == 0:
468                            pth_egsphant_file = None
469                else:
470                    raise ValueError(
471                        "invalid directory. Please provide a directory containing dicom or nrrd files"
472                    )
473        else:
474            assert (
475                os.path.splitext(pth_phantom)[1] == ".json"
476            ), "invalid file format. Please provide a json file"
477            with open(pth_phantom, "r") as json_file:
478                phantom_config = json.load(json_file)
479            for key in phantom_config:
480                if key == "dir_dicom":
481                    dir_dicom = phantom_config.get(key)
482                elif key == "pth_phantom_file":
483                    pth_phantom_file = phantom_config.get(key)
484                elif key == "pth_structures_file":
485                    pth_structures_file = phantom_config.get(key)
486                elif key == "pth_egsphant_file":
487                    pth_egsphant_file = phantom_config.get(key)
488
489        # load the phantom
490        self.phantom = BrachyPhantom(
491            dir_dicom=dir_dicom,
492            pth_phantom_file=pth_phantom_file,
493            pth_structures_file=pth_structures_file,
494            pth_egsphant_file=pth_egsphant_file,
495        )
496        self.phantom_origin = self.phantom.image_obj.origin

def set_catheter_table( self, catheter_table: Union[pathlib._local.Path, brachyutils.geometry.catheter_utils.catheter_table.CatheterTable], from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True, dwells_near_ptv: bool = True): 
498    def set_catheter_table(
499        self,
500        catheter_table: Union[Path, CatheterTable],
501        from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool = True,
502        dwells_near_ptv: bool = True,):
503        r"""
504        ### Purpose:
505        - To set the catheter table of the plan and update the plan attributes accordingly.
506        ### Inputs:
507        - catheter_table: Path | CatheterTable := A catheter table object or the path to a
508        json file containing the information of the catheter table.
509        - from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := Whether to load only the delivered dwell positions
510        from the catheter table. Only applicable if the catheter table is loaded from a DICOM plan file. 
511        If False, all the dwell positions from the digitization points will be loaded.
512        - dwells_near_ptv: bool := Whether to remove dwells that are far from the PTV.
513        ### Outputs:
514        - Void := will update the BrachyPlan.catheter_table attribute and all the related attributes
515        such as dwell times, coordinates, etc.
516        """
517        if isinstance(catheter_table, (str, Path)):
518            self.catheter_table = CatheterTable(
519                catheters_dict=catheter_table,
520                from_delivered_dwellpositions=from_delivered_dwellpositions,
521                )
522        elif isinstance(catheter_table, CatheterTable):
523            if self.catheter_table is None:
524                self.catheter_table = catheter_table
525            else:
526                self.catheter_table.merge(catheter_table)
527        else:
528            raise ValueError(
529                "catheter_table should be a path or a CatheterTable object"
530            )
531        if dwells_near_ptv:
532            for structure in self.structure_list:
533                if structure.is_target:
534                    if isinstance(structure.mask, ROIContour):
535                        mask = structure.mask.getBinaryMask(
536                            origin=self.phantom.image_obj.origin,
537                            gridSize=self.phantom.image_obj.gridSize,
538                            spacing=self.phantom.image_obj.spacing,
539                        )
540                    else:
541                        mask = structure.mask
542                    self.catheter_table.remove_outside_mask(
543                        mask=mask,
544                        margin_mm=5.0,
545                    )
546        self.update_plan_from_catheter_table(
547            time_diffs=self.catheter_table._time_diffs)

  • from_delivered_dwellpositions: bool := Whether to load only the delivered dwell positions from the catheter table. Only applicable if the catheter table is loaded from a DICOM plan file. If False, all the dwell positions from the digitization points will be loaded.

  • dwells_near_ptv: bool := Whether to remove dwells that are far from the PTV.

def update_plan_from_catheter_table(self, time_diffs=None): 
549    def update_plan_from_catheter_table(self, time_diffs=None):
550        r"""
551        ### Purpose:
552        - To extract the dwell numbers, times, and coordinates from the catheter table
553        and save them as class attributes.
554        ### Inputs:
555        - self := the BrachyPlan object
556        - time_diffs: dict := A dictionary of time differences for each dwell position. this is used for fast plan update.
557        ### Outputs:
558        - Void := will update the self.dwell_numbers, self.dwell_times,
559        and self.dwell_coordinates attributes
560        """
561
562        assert self.catheter_table is not None, "catheter table is not loaded"
563        # reset the dwell_numbers, dwell times, coordinates, and num dwells
564        if time_diffs is None: #I think this code is deprecated and is bottlenecking our hackathon project
565            (
566                self.catheter_numbers,
567                self.dwell_numbers,
568                self.dwell_times,
569                self.dwell_coordinates,
570            ) = (
571                np.array([], dtype=int),
572                np.array([], dtype=int),
573                np.array([], dtype=np.float32),
574                [],
575            )
576            self.num_catheters = None
577            self.num_dwells = None
578
579            # extract the attributes above from the catheter table
580            dwell_counter = 1
581            for catheter in self.catheter_table.catheters_list:
582                self.catheter_numbers = np.append(self.catheter_numbers, catheter.index)
583                for dwell in catheter.dwells:
584                    self.dwell_numbers = np.append(self.dwell_numbers, dwell_counter)
585                    self.dwell_times = np.append(self.dwell_times, dwell.time)
586                    self.dwell_coordinates.append(
587                        {
588                            "angle": dwell.angle,
589                            "position": dwell.position,
590                            "rotation": dwell.rotation,
591                            "relativePos": dwell.relativePos,
592                            "catheter_index": catheter.index,
593                            "dwell_index": dwell.index,
594                        }
595                    )
596                    dwell_counter += 1
597            assert (
598                len(self.catheter_numbers) - 1 == self.catheter_numbers[-1]
599            ), "catheter numbers are not extracted correctly"
600            self.num_catheters = len(self.catheter_numbers)
601            assert (
602                len(self.dwell_numbers) == self.dwell_numbers[-1]
603            ), "dwell numbers are not extracted correctly"
604            self.num_dwells = len(self.dwell_numbers)

Purpose:

  • To extract the dwell numbers, times, and coordinates from the catheter table and save them as class attributes.

    Inputs:

  • self := the BrachyPlan object

  • time_diffs: dict := A dictionary of time differences for each dwell position. this is used for fast plan update.

    Outputs:

  • Void := will update the self.dwell_numbers, self.dwell_times, and self.dwell_coordinates attributes

def set_dvh_metric_goals( self, dvh_metric_names: Union[List[str], pathlib._local.Path] = None, dvh_metric_goals: dict | pathlib._local.Path = None, strict_name_match: bool = True) -> None: 
606    def set_dvh_metric_goals(
607        self,
608        dvh_metric_names: List[str] | Path = None,
609        dvh_metric_goals: dict | Path = None,
610        strict_name_match: bool = True
611        ) -> None:
612        r"""
613        ### Purpose:
614        - To set the dvh metric list of the BrachyPlan object and each of the BrachyStructures.
615        You can provide either the dvh_metric_names or the dvh_metric_goals.
616        ### Inputs:
617        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
618        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
619        For example D95%(organName).
620        - dvh_metric_goals:Dict[str, float] := a dictionary of DVH metrics and their clinical goals.
621        The keys should be following the same convention as for dvh_metric_names.
622        - strict_name_match: bool := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric
623        goals should mask perfectly. Otherwise, the name of the structure in the DVH metric goals can be
624        a substring of the name of the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".
625        ### Outputs:
626        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals attribute as well as 
627        BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_names and BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_goals.
628        The keys of the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals are:
629        {
630            BrachyStructure.name: {
631                "dvh_metric_names: [list of the names for that structure],
632                "dvh_metric_goals: {if applicable}
633            }    
634        }
635        """
636        if dvh_metric_names is not None and dvh_metric_goals is not None:
637            raise ValueError("Please provide either dvh_metric_names or dvh_metric_goals, not both") 
638
639        if len(self.structure_list) == 0:
640            raise ValueError("The plan structure set is empty, please run set_brachy_structure_list")
641
642        if isinstance(dvh_metric_names, Path):
643            with open(dvh_metric_names, "r") as json_file:
644                dvh_metric_names = json.load(json_file)
645
646        if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
647            if isinstance(dvh_metric_goals, Path):
648                with open(dvh_metric_goals, "r") as json_file:
649                    dvh_metric_goals = json.load(json_file)
650            dvh_metric_names = list(dvh_metric_goals.keys())
651
652        self.dvh_metric_goals = defaultdict(dict)
653        # let's match the structure names in the DVH with the structure names
654        # in the BrachyPlan.
655        for brachy_structure in self.structure_list:
656            # get all the dvh metrics for this structure
657            structure_dvh_metrics_names = []
658            for dvh_name in dvh_metric_names:
659                structure_name_in_dvh = dvh_name.split("(")[-1].split(")")[0]
660                if strict_name_match:
661                    if brachy_structure.name == structure_name_in_dvh:
662                        structure_dvh_metrics_names.append(dvh_name)
663                    else:
664                        continue
665                else:
666                    if structure_name_in_dvh in brachy_structure.name:
667                        structure_dvh_metrics_names.append(dvh_name)
668                    else:
669                        continue
670            self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
671                "dvh_metric_names": structure_dvh_metrics_names
672            }
673            brachy_structure.set_dvh_metric_names(
674                self.dvh_metric_goals.get(brachy_structure.name).get("dvh_metric_names")
675            )
676            if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
677                self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
678                        "dvh_metric_goals": {}}
679                for dvh_name in structure_dvh_metrics_names:
680                    self.dvh_metric_goals[brachy_structure.name] = {
681                        "dvh_metric_goals": {
682                            dvh_name: dvh_metric_goals[dvh_name]
683                        }
684                    }
685                brachy_structure.set_dvh_metric_goals(
686                    self.dvh_metric_goals.get(brachy_structure.name).get("dvh_metric_goals")
687                )

Purpose:

  • To set the dvh metric list of the BrachyPlan object and each of the BrachyStructures. You can provide either the dvh_metric_names or the dvh_metric_goals.

    Inputs:

  • dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or. For example D95%(organName).

  • dvh_metric_goals:Dict[str, float] := a dictionary of DVH metrics and their clinical goals. The keys should be following the same convention as for dvh_metric_names.

  • strict_name_match: bool := If True, the name of the structure in the phantom and the DVH metric goals should mask perfectly. Otherwise, the name of the structure in the DVH metric goals can be a substring of the name of the structure in the phantom. For example, "CTV" in "CTV_BRACHY".

    Outputs:

  • None := will update the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals attribute as well as BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_names and BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_goals. The keys of the BrachyPlan.dvh_metric_goals are: { BrachyStructure.name: { "dvh_metric_names: [list of the names for that structure], "dvh_metric_goals: {if applicable} }
    }

def set_brachy_structure_list( self, phantom: brachyutils.geometry.BrachyPhantom, mask_type: Union[opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour, opentps.core.data.images._roiMask.ROIMask] = <class 'opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour'>) -> None: 
689    def set_brachy_structure_list(
690        self,
691        phantom: BrachyPhantom,
692        mask_type: Union[ROIContour, ROIMask] = ROIContour,
693        )->None:
694        r"""
695        ### Purpose:
696        - To create a list of BrachyStructure objects from the structures in the phantom and
697        the DVH metric goals. Each BrachyStructure object will have attributes for the structure
698        contour, the DVH and uncertainty volume histograms, optimization attributes, and simulation attributes.
699        ### Inputes:
700        - phantom := the phantom with its structures fully loaded.
701        - dvh_metric_goals := the dvh metric goals dictionary
702        - mask_type: ROIContour | ROIMask := Phantom masks will be converted to this type when being
703        stored in BrachySturucture.
704        ### Outputs:
705        - None := will update the BrachyPlan.structure_list attribute
706        """
707        self.structure_list = []
708        if phantom.cached_structure_masks is not None:
709            structure_masks = deepcopy(phantom.cached_structure_masks)
710        else:
711            structure_masks: dict = phantom.get_structure_mask(
712                phantom.structure_names, mask_type,
713            )
714
715        for structure_name in structure_masks.keys():
716            structure_obj = BrachyStructure(
717                name=structure_name,
718                mask=structure_masks[structure_name],
719                is_target=True if (
720                    "ctv" in structure_name.lower()
721                    or "ptv" in structure_name.lower())  else False,
722            )
723            self.structure_list.append(structure_obj)
724        if phantom.cached_structure_masks is not None:
725            body_key = None
726            for k in phantom.cached_structure_masks.keys():
727                if k.lower() == "body":
728                    body_key = k
729            self.body_contour = phantom.cached_structure_masks.get(body_key, None)
730        else:
731            self.body_contour = phantom.get_structure_mask(
732                ["body"], ROIContour, strict_name_match=False
733            ).get("body", None)

def load_applicator_list( self, applicator_list_pth: Union[list, pathlib._local.Path, str], format: Literal['WebApp', 'RapidBrachy'] = 'WebApp'): 
735    def load_applicator_list(
736        self,
737        applicator_list_pth: Union[list, Path, str],
738        format: Literal["WebApp", "RapidBrachy"] = "WebApp",
739    ):
740        r"""
741        ### Purpose:
742        - To load the applicator list from a json file containing the applicator geometry.
743        ### Inputs:
744        - applicator_list_pth:str := path to the json file containing the applicator list with N applicators.
745        The items inside this list have the attributes bellow. If any left empty, the default value will be used.
746        these attributes could be changed later using the setter functions.
747
748        if the format is WebApp, the attributes are:
749            - "path": path to the applicator geometry file (.stl or .json).
750            - "material": material of the applicator (str).
751            - "density": density of the applicator (str).
752            - "origin": origin of the applicator ([x,y,z]).
753            - "rotation": rotation of the applicator ([w,x,y,z]).
754            - "rotation_origin": origin of the rotation ([x,y,z]).
755            - "coordinates": coordinates of the applicator ([x,y,z]).
756
757        if the format is RapidBrachy, the attributes are:
758            - "densities": list of densities of the applicator.
759            - "filenames": list of filenames of the applicator.
760            - "materials": list of materials of the applicator.
761            - "points": list of points (x,y,z,x,y,z) describing the first and last dwell positions
762            on the applicator in the frame of the applicator.
763            - "shieldNormalx": normal of applicator in the x direction in the frame of CT.
764            - "shieldNormaly": normal of applicator in the y direction in the frame of CT.
765            - "shieldNormalz": normal of applicator in the z direction in the frame of CT.
766            - "wRot": list of wRot of the applicator.
767            - "x": list of x of the applicator.
768            - "xRoti": list of xRot of the applicator i in [1, N].
769            - "y": list of y of the applicator.
770            - "yRoti": list of yRot of the applicator i in [1, N].
771            - "z": list of z of the applicator.
772            - "zRoti": list of zRot of the applicator i in [1, N].
773
774        - format:str := the format of the applicator geometry file. options are "RapidBrachy" or "WebApp"
775        ### Outputs:
776            - Void := will update the BrachyPlan.applicator_list attribute
777        """
778        if isinstance(applicator_list_pth, Path) or isinstance(
779            applicator_list_pth, str
780        ):
781            with open(applicator_list_pth, "r") as json_file:
782                applicator_list = json.load(json_file)
783        if format == "RapidBrachy":
784            num_applicators = len(applicator_list["densities"])
785
786            for i in range(num_applicators):
787
788                j = i + 1 if i >= 1 else ""
789                shieldNormal = np.array(
790                    [
791                        (
792                            applicator_list["shieldNormalx"]
793                            if "shieldNormalx" in applicator_list
794                            else 0
795                        ),
796                        (
797                            applicator_list["shieldNormaly"]
798                            if "shieldNormaly" in applicator_list
799                            else 0
800                        ),
801                        (
802                            applicator_list["shieldNormalz"]
803                            if "shieldNormalz" in applicator_list
804                            else 0
805                        ),
806                    ]
807                )
808
809                rotation = np.array(
810                    [
811                        (
812                            applicator_list[f"wRot{j}"]
813                            if f"wRot{j}" in applicator_list
814                            else 0
815                        ),
816                        (
817                            applicator_list[f"xRot{j}"]
818                            if f"xRot{j}" in applicator_list
819                            else 0
820                        ),
821                        (
822                            applicator_list[f"yRot{j}"]
823                            if f"yRot{j}" in applicator_list
824                            else 0
825                        ),
826                        (
827                            applicator_list[f"zRot{j}"]
828                            if f"zRot{j}" in applicator_list
829                            else 0
830                        ),
831                    ]
832                )
833
834                applicator_obj = BrachyApplicator(
835                    pth_input_file=applicator_list["filenames"][i],
836                    material=applicator_list["materials"][i],
837                    density=applicator_list["densities"][i],
838                    origin=self.patient_origin,
839                    rotation=rotation,
840                    rotation_origin=np.array(
841                        [
842                            applicator_list["x"],
843                            applicator_list["y"],
844                            applicator_list["z"],
845                        ]
846                    ),
847                    coordinates=np.array(
848                        [
849                            applicator_list["x"],
850                            applicator_list["y"],
851                            applicator_list["z"],
852                        ]
853                    ),
854                    normal=shieldNormal,
855                    # for now RapidBrachy exports only one catheter trajectory.
856                    # in future, more catheter trajectories may be possible.
857                    # use i instead of 0 to get the ith catheter trajectory.
858                    catheter_trajectory=np.array(
859                        [
860                            applicator_list["points"][0][0:3],
861                            applicator_list["points"][0][3:6],
862                        ]
863                    ),
864                )
865
866                self.applicator_list.append(applicator_obj)
867
868        elif format == "WebApp":
869            for applicator in applicator_list:
870
871                applicator_obj = BrachyApplicator(
872                    pth_input_file=applicator["path"] if "path" in applicator else None,
873                    material=(
874                        applicator["material"] if "material" in applicator else None
875                    ),
876                    density=applicator["density"] if "density" in applicator else None,
877                    origin=applicator["origin"] if "origin" in applicator else None,
878                    rotation=(
879                        applicator["rotation"] if "rotation" in applicator else None
880                    ),
881                    rotation_origin=(
882                        applicator["rotation_origin"]
883                        if "rotation_origin" in applicator
884                        else None
885                    ),
886                    coordinates=(
887                        applicator["coordinates"]
888                        if "coordinates" in applicator
889                        else None
890                    ),
891                    normal=applicator["normal"] if "normal" in applicator else None,
892                    catheter_trajectory=(
893                        applicator["catheter_trajectory"]
894                        if "catheter_trajectory" in applicator
895                        else None
896                    ),
897                )
898                self.applicator_list.append(applicator_obj)
899        else:
900            raise ValueError("format should be either 'RapidBrachy' or 'WebApp'")

if the format is WebApp, the attributes are: - "path": path to the applicator geometry file (.stl or .json). - "material": material of the applicator (str). - "density": density of the applicator (str). - "origin": origin of the applicator ([x,y,z]). - "rotation": rotation of the applicator ([w,x,y,z]). - "rotation_origin": origin of the rotation ([x,y,z]). - "coordinates": coordinates of the applicator ([x,y,z]).

if the format is RapidBrachy, the attributes are: - "densities": list of densities of the applicator. - "filenames": list of filenames of the applicator. - "materials": list of materials of the applicator. - "points": list of points (x,y,z,x,y,z) describing the first and last dwell positions on the applicator in the frame of the applicator. - "shieldNormalx": normal of applicator in the x direction in the frame of CT. - "shieldNormaly": normal of applicator in the y direction in the frame of CT. - "shieldNormalz": normal of applicator in the z direction in the frame of CT. - "wRot": list of wRot of the applicator. - "x": list of x of the applicator. - "xRoti": list of xRot of the applicator i in [1, N]. - "y": list of y of the applicator. - "yRoti": list of yRot of the applicator i in [1, N]. - "z": list of z of the applicator. - "zRoti": list of zRot of the applicator i in [1, N].

def get_dvh_metrics( self, combined_dose: brachyutils.dose.BrachyDose = None, prescription_dose: float = None, return_percentage: bool = True) -> dict: 
902    def get_dvh_metrics(
903        self,
904        combined_dose: BrachyDose=None,
905        prescription_dose: float = None,
906        return_percentage: bool = True,
907        ) -> dict:
908        r"""
909        ### Purpose:
910        - To get the observed value of the dvh metric for each structure in the BrachyPlan.
911        the observed value is calculated from the combined dose map.
912        ### Inputs:
913        - self := the BrachyPlan object
914        ### Outputs:
915        - dvh_metrics_observed: a dictionary mapping every DVH metric to its observed value.
916        """
917        assert self.structure_list is not None, "structure list is not created yet"
918        assert self.prescription_dose is not None, "prescription dose is not set"
919        assert self.dvh_metric_goals is not None, "DVH metrics are not set, please run set_dvh_metric_goals()"
920        if combined_dose is None:
921            combined_dose = self.combined_dose
922        if prescription_dose is None:
923            prescription_dose = self.prescription_dose
924        dvh_metrics_observed = {}
925        for structure_obj in self.structure_list:
926            if "hotspot_estimator" in structure_obj.name.lower():
927                continue
928            if not any(structure_obj.dvh_metric_names):
929                continue
930            observed_metrics = structure_obj.get_dvh_metric(
931                combined_dose,
932                prescription_dose,
933                return_percentage,
934                self.body_contour,
935                )
936            dvh_metrics_observed.update(observed_metrics)
937        return dvh_metrics_observed

Purpose:

  • To get the observed value of the dvh metric for each structure in the BrachyPlan. the observed value is calculated from the combined dose map.

    Inputs:

  • self := the BrachyPlan object

    Outputs:

  • dvh_metrics_observed: a dictionary mapping every DVH metric to its observed value.

def calculate_uncertainty_per_structure(self): 
 967    def calculate_uncertainty_per_structure(self):
 968        r"""
 969        ### Purpose:
 970        - To calculate the uncertainty of each structure in the BrachyPlan.
 971        ### Inputs:
 972        - self := the BrachyPlan object
 973        ### Outputs:
 974        - Void := will update the BrachyStructure.uncertainty attribute
 975        """
 976        assert (
 977            self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image is not None
 978        ), "combined uncertainty is not calculated yet"
 979        assert self.structure_list is not None, "structure list is not created yet"
 980        from opentps.core.processing.imageProcessing.resampler3D import (
 981            resampleImage3DOnImage3D,
 982        )
 983
 984        for structure_obj in self.structure_list:
 985            # resample the uncertainty image on the structure
 986            structure_mask = structure_obj.mask.getBinaryMask(
 987                origin=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.origin,
 988                spacing=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.spacing,
 989                gridSize=self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.gridSize
 990            )
 991            masked_uncertainty = self.combined_dose.uncertainty_image.imageArray * structure_mask.imageArray
 992
 993            # isolate the uncertainty values that are in the mask
 994            flattened_uncertainty = masked_uncertainty.flatten()
 995            # generate a histogram from the masked uncertainty
 996            histogram, bins_edges = np.histogram(
 997                flattened_uncertainty,
 998                bins=100,
 999                range=(0, flattened_uncertainty.max() + 0.1),
1000            )
1001            structure_obj.uvh = histogram * np.prod(self.combined_dose.dose_image.spacing)
1002            structure_obj.uncertainty_mean = np.mean(flattened_uncertainty)
1003            structure_obj.uncertainty_std = np.std(flattened_uncertainty)
1004            structure_obj.uncertainty_max = np.max(flattened_uncertainty)
1005            structure_obj.uncertainty_min = np.min(flattened_uncertainty)

Purpose:

  • To calculate the uncertainty of each structure in the BrachyPlan.

    Inputs:

  • self := the BrachyPlan object

    Outputs:

  • Void := will update the BrachyStructure.uncertainty attribute

def export_brachy_plan( self, content_to_export: brachyutils.planning.plan_utils.ExportConfig_BrachyPlan | dict): 
1007    def export_brachy_plan(
1008        self,
1009        content_to_export: ExportConfig_BrachyPlan | dict,
1010        ):
1011        r"""
1012        ### Purpose:
1013        - To export the brachytherapy treatment plan and its components to files based on the
1014        provided export configuration. Supports exporting dose, catheter tables, plan files,
1015        simulation macros, egsphant files, applicator geometries, and structure sets.
1016
1017        ### Inputs:
1018        - content_to_export := ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object or dictionary containing export
1019        configuration. If a dictionary is provided, it will be converted to an ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object.
1020        
1021        The configuration object/dictionary should contain:
1022            - dir_export (Path): Directory where exported files will be written.
1023            - export_config_dose (ExportConfig_Dose|None): Dose export configuration.
1024            - export_config_cathetertable (ExportConfig_CatheterTable|None): Catheter table export configuration.
1025            - export_config_planfile (ExportConfig_PlanFile|None): Plan file export configuration.
1026            - export_config_macfile (ExportConfig_MacFile|None): Macro file export configuration.
1027            - export_config_egsphant (ExportConfig_Egsphant|None): Egsphant file export configuration.
1028            - applicator_geometry (bool): Whether to export applicator geometry.
1029            - structure_set (bool): Whether to export structure set.
1030
1031        ### Outputs:
1032        - None := Exported files are written to the directory specified in content_to_export.dir_export.
1033        The function conditionally exports the following file types based on configuration:
1034            - Dose files (combined dose and optionally dose rate maps)
1035            - Catheter table (.json or .mrk.json)
1036            - Plan files (.plan files for each dwell position)
1037            - Macro files (.mac simulation files)
1038            - Egsphant phantom file (ct.egsphant)
1039            - Applicator geometry files (applicator_geometry.json and .mac files)
1040            - Structure set file (structure_set.json)
1041
1042        ### Dependencies:
1043        - ExportConfig_BrachyPlan
1044        - export_dose()
1045        - export_catheter_table()
1046        - export_plan_files()
1047        - export_mac_files()
1048        - _export_egsphant()
1049        - _export_applicator_geometry()
1050        - _export_structure_set()
1051        """
1052        if isinstance(content_to_export, dict):
1053            content_to_export = ExportConfig_BrachyPlan(**content_to_export)
1054        dir_export = content_to_export.dir_export
1055        dir_export.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1056
1057        if content_to_export.export_config_dose:
1058            self.catheter_table.export_dose(content_to_export.export_config_dose)
1059
1060        if content_to_export.export_config_cathetertable:
1061            self.export_catheter_table(
1062                export_config_cathetertable=content_to_export.export_config_cathetertable,
1063                catheter_table=self.catheter_table,
1064            )
1065
1066        if content_to_export.export_config_planfile:
1067            self.export_plan_files(
1068                export_config_planfile=content_to_export.export_config_planfile,
1069                catheter_table=self.catheter_table,
1070                )
1071
1072        if content_to_export.export_config_macfile:
1073            self.export_mac_files(
1074                export_config_macfile=content_to_export.export_config_macfile,
1075                catheter_table=self.catheter_table
1076                )
1077
1078        if content_to_export.export_config_egsphant:
1079            self._export_egsphant(
1080                export_config_egsphant=content_to_export.export_config_egsphant
1081            )
1082
1083        if content_to_export.applicator_geometry:
1084            self._export_applicator_geometry(str(content_to_export.dir_export))
1085
1086        if content_to_export.structure_set:
1087            self._export_structure_set(
1088                str(dir_export), content_to_export.get("materials_table", None)
1089            )

Purpose:

  • To export the brachytherapy treatment plan and its components to files based on the provided export configuration. Supports exporting dose, catheter tables, plan files, simulation macros, egsphant files, applicator geometries, and structure sets.

Inputs:

  • content_to_export := ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object or dictionary containing export configuration. If a dictionary is provided, it will be converted to an ExportConfig_BrachyPlan object.

The configuration object/dictionary should contain: - dir_export (Path): Directory where exported files will be written. - export_config_dose (ExportConfig_Dose|None): Dose export configuration. - export_config_cathetertable (ExportConfig_CatheterTable|None): Catheter table export configuration. - export_config_planfile (ExportConfig_PlanFile|None): Plan file export configuration. - export_config_macfile (ExportConfig_MacFile|None): Macro file export configuration. - export_config_egsphant (ExportConfig_Egsphant|None): Egsphant file export configuration. - applicator_geometry (bool): Whether to export applicator geometry. - structure_set (bool): Whether to export structure set.

Outputs:

  • None := Exported files are written to the directory specified in content_to_export.dir_export. The function conditionally exports the following file types based on configuration:
    • Dose files (combined dose and optionally dose rate maps)
    • Catheter table (.json or .mrk.json)
    • Plan files (.plan files for each dwell position)
    • Macro files (.mac simulation files)
    • Egsphant phantom file (ct.egsphant)
    • Applicator geometry files (applicator_geometry.json and .mac files)

def export_catheter_table( self, export_config_cathetertable: brachyutils.planning.plan_utils.ExportConfig_CatheterTable, catheter_table: brachyutils.geometry.catheter_utils.catheter_table.CatheterTable): 
1091    def export_catheter_table(
1092        self,
1093        export_config_cathetertable: ExportConfig_CatheterTable,
1094        catheter_table: CatheterTable,
1095        ):
1096        r"""
1097        ### Purpose:
1098        - to export the catheter table to a given directory in mrk.json or .json format.
1099        ### Inputs:
1100        - export_config_cathetertable: The catheter table export configuration. Look at ExportConfig_CatheterTable for more info
1101        - catheter_table: The catheter table to export.
1102        ### Outputs:
1103        - None := will export the catheter table into the specified export directory.
1104        """
1105        if export_config_cathetertable.file_extension == "mrk.json":
1106            catheter_table.write_to_slicer_markup(
1107                pth_mrk_json=export_config_cathetertable.pth_catheter_table,
1108                remove_text=export_config_cathetertable.remove_text,
1109                one_markup_per_catheter=export_config_cathetertable.one_markup_per_catheter,
1110            )
1111        elif export_config_cathetertable.file_extension == ".json":
1112            catheter_table.write_json(
1113                export_config_cathetertable.dir_export
1114            )

def export_plan_files( self, export_config_planfile: brachyutils.planning.plan_utils.ExportConfig_PlanFile, catheter_table: brachyutils.geometry.catheter_utils.catheter_table.CatheterTable): 
1116    def export_plan_files(
1117        self,
1118        export_config_planfile:ExportConfig_PlanFile,
1119        catheter_table:CatheterTable,
1120        ):
1121        r"""
1122        ### Purpose:
1123        - To export dwell positions and their normalized times into ".plan" text files in the
1124        format required by RapidBrachy.
1125        ### Inputs:
1126        - export_config_planfile:= The export configuration for the plan files. see ExportConfig_PlanFile
1127        - catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.
1128        ### Outputs:
1129        - void := Two types of .plan files are written, one named combined.plan and the other
1130        named run_{dwellNumber}.plan. combined.plan contains info of all dwell positions and
1131        their normalized dwell time, and the run_{dwellNumber}.plan contains info of a single
1132        dwell position. The format of each .plan file is given in this example:
1133            "Treatment Plan
1134            56 Control Points
1135            Control Point
1136            weight = 0.00327228
1137            1 Dwell Position
1138            -10.2819,82.598,-1224.98,-0.0291444,-0.017922,0.999415,0,0,0,1,0,0,0
1139            Control Point ..."
1140        ### Dependencies:
1141            - None
1142        """
1143        # total_dwell_time = np.sum(self.dwell_times)
1144        cath_table_dose_gen = catheter_table.get_catheters_for_dose_gen()
1145        total_dwell_time = cath_table_dose_gen.treatment_time
1146        num_dwells = cath_table_dose_gen.num_dwell_positions
1147        combined_plan = "Treatment Plan\n"
1148        combined_plan += f"{num_dwells} Control Points\n"
1149
1150        for cat in catheter_table:
1151            # skip if no need to export for dose rate calculation
1152            if not cat.gen_dose_rates:
1153                continue
1154            for dwell in cat.dwells:
1155                dwell_coordinates_str = np.array(
1156                    list(dwell.position)
1157                    + list(dwell.rotation)
1158                    + [dwell.angle]
1159                    + list(self.applicator_rotation_axis)
1160                    + list(self.applicator_rotation_origin),
1161                    dtype=np.float32,
1162                )
1163                dwell_coordinates_str = (
1164                    ",".join(
1165                        [
1166                            str(int(coord)) if coord == int(coord) else format(coord, ".6f")
1167                            for coord in dwell_coordinates_str
1168                        ]
1169                    )
1170                    + "\n"
1171                )
1172
1173                catheter_idx = cat.index
1174                dwell_idx = dwell.index
1175                combined_plan += "Control Point\n"
1176                combined_plan += f"weight = {dwell.time/total_dwell_time}\n"
1177                combined_plan += f"1 Dwell Position - Catheter {catheter_idx + 1}\n"
1178                combined_plan += dwell_coordinates_str
1179
1180                run_i_plan = "Treatment Plan\n"
1181                run_i_plan += "1 Control Points\n"
1182                run_i_plan += "Control Point\nweight = 1.0\n"
1183                run_i_plan += "1 Dwell Position\n"
1184                run_i_plan += dwell_coordinates_str
1185                # Not dealing with shield angle for now but the new convention for filename is
1186                # xxx_catheter#_dwell#_shieldangle.plan
1187                shield_angle = 0
1188                if not export_config_planfile.combined_only:
1189                    order = f"{catheter_idx + 1}_{dwell_idx + 1}_{shield_angle}"
1190                    with open(export_config_planfile.dir_export / f"dwell_{order}.plan", "w") as file:
1191                        file.write(run_i_plan)
1192            # set to false so that we don't export the same catheter again for dose rate calculation
1193            cat.gen_dose_rates = False
1194        with open(export_config_planfile.pth_combined, "w") as file:
1195            file.write(combined_plan)
1196        print(".plan files were exported successfully")

The format of each .plan file is given in this example: "Treatment Plan 56 Control Points Control Point weight = 0.00327228 1 Dwell Position -10.2819,82.598,-1224.98,-0.0291444,-0.017922,0.999415,0,0,0,1,0,0,0 Control Point ..."

def export_mac_files( self, export_config_macfile: brachyutils.planning.plan_utils.ExportConfig_MacFile, catheter_table: brachyutils.geometry.catheter_utils.catheter_table.CatheterTable): 
1198    def export_mac_files(
1199        self,
1200        export_config_macfile: ExportConfig_MacFile,
1201        catheter_table:CatheterTable,
1202        ):
1203        r"""
1204        ### Purpose:
1205        - To export the simulation parameters of the plan into a macro files
1206        and run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac
1207        ### Inputs:
1208        - export_config_macfile:= The export configuration for macro files.
1209        - catheter_table:= The catheter table with the dwells.
1210        ### Outputs:
1211        - None := Two types of .mac files are written, one named combined.mac and the other
1212        named run_{catheterNumber}_{dwellNumber}_{shieldAngle}.mac. combined.plan contains
1213
1214        plan contains info of a single dwell position.
1215
1216        The format of each .mac file is given in this example:
1217            /source_world/treatmentType HDR
1218            /source_world/switch MicroSelectronV2
1219            /source_world/coreMaterial G4_Ir
1220            /source_world/core/A 192
1221            /source_world/core/Z 77
1222            /sim/plan combined.plan
1223            /world/phantom ct.egsphant
1224            /parallel_world/ak_per_history 1.149000e-11
1225            /parallel_world/ref_ak 4.278729e+04
1226            /parallel_world/H 2.500000e+00
1227            /parallel_world/total_time 4.531841e+02
1228            /dose/format 3ddose
1229            /run/numberOfThreads 40
1230            /run/initialize
1231            /control/verbose 0
1232            /run/verbose 0
1233            /tracking/verbose 0
1234            /run/printProgress 1000000
1235            /sim/beamOn 10000000
1236        ### Dependencies:
1237        - simulation_utils
1238        """
1239        sim_obj = deepcopy(self.simulation_setup)
1240        sim_obj.total_time = catheter_table.treatment_time
1241        sim_obj.pth_plan = export_config_macfile.pth_plan
1242        sim_obj.pth_phantom = export_config_macfile.pth_phantom
1243
1244        with open(export_config_macfile.pth_combined, "w") as file:
1245            file.write(sim_obj.to_string())
1246
1247        if not export_config_macfile.combined_only:
1248            for cat in catheter_table:
1249                for dwell in cat.dwells:
1250                    catheter_idx = cat.index
1251                    dwell_idx = dwell.index
1252                    # Not dealing with shield angle for now but the new convention for filename is
1253                    # xxx_catheter#_dwell#_shieldangle.plan
1254                    shield_angle = 0
1255                    sim_obj = deepcopy(self.simulation_setup)
1256                    order = f"{catheter_idx + 1}_{dwell_idx + 1}_{shield_angle}"
1257                    sim_obj.pth_plan = f"dwell_{order}.plan"
1258                    sim_obj.total_time = 1
1259
1260                    with open(export_config_macfile.dir_export / f"run_{order}.mac", "w") as file:
1261                        file.write(sim_obj.to_string())
1262        print(".mac files were exported successfully")

def setup_optimization( self, optimization_config_list: Union[List[brachyutils.planning.optimization.optim_utils.Optimization_Config], pathlib._local.Path, str], structure_list: List[BrachyStructure], add_hotspots_to_phantom: bool = False, one_hotspot_structure: bool = True): 
1444    def setup_optimization(
1445        self, 
1446        optimization_config_list:List[Optimization_Config] | Path | str,
1447        structure_list:List[BrachyStructure],
1448        add_hotspots_to_phantom:bool=False,
1449        one_hotspot_structure:bool=True
1450        ):
1451        r"""
1452        ### Purpose:
1453        - Given the optimization config list either as a list or in a json file, put each
1454        optimization config inside the BrachyStructures. Also, create the hotspot estimator
1455        structure if needed.
1456        """
1457        self._reset_optimization()
1458        if isinstance(optimization_config_list, (Path, str)):
1459            optimization_config_list = Path(optimization_config_list).resolve()
1460            if str(optimization_config_list).endswith(".json"):
1461                with open(optimization_config_list, "r") as json_file:
1462                    optimization_config_list = json.load(json_file)
1463            else:
1464                raise ValueError("optimization_config_list can be a json file or a list of Optimization_Config objects")
1465        target_structure_names = [
1466            structure.name.lower() for structure in self.structure_list
1467            if structure.is_target
1468            ]
1469        for config in optimization_config_list:
1470            if config.penalty_weight_hotspot != 0:
1471                if config.structure_name.lower() not in target_structure_names:
1472                    raise ValueError(
1473                        "penalty_weight_hotspot can only be set for PTV or CTV structures"
1474                    )
1475                self._create_hotspot_structures(
1476                    target_optim_config=config,
1477                    add_hotspots_to_phantom=add_hotspots_to_phantom,
1478                    one_hotspot_structure=one_hotspot_structure)
1479            for struc in structure_list:
1480                if config.structure_name.lower() == struc.name.lower():
1481                    assert config.is_target == struc.is_target, f"The target structure in plan and optimization \
1482config do not match for structure {struc.name}"
1483                    struc.set_optimization_config(config)
1484                    break

def get_dose_rate_matrices_for_catheter( self, catheter_index: int) -> Dict[str, brachyutils.dose.BrachyDose]: 
1617    def get_dose_rate_matrices_for_catheter(
1618        self,
1619        catheter_index: int
1620    ) -> Dict[str, BrachyDose]:
1621        r"""
1622        ### Purpose:
1623        - to get the dose rate matrices for all dwell positions in a given catheter.
1624        this function assumes that dose rate dictionary matches the index+1 convension.
1625        ### Inputs:
1626        - catheter_index := the index of the catheter in the catheter table
1627        ### Outputs:
1628        - Dict[BrachyDose]: A dictionary containing the dose rates for the speicific catheter.
1629        the keys are in the format catheter_{index+1}_dwell_{index+1}
1630        """
1631        catheter = self.catheter_table[catheter_index]
1632        dose_rates_catheter = defaultdict(BrachyDose)
1633        for dwell in catheter:
1634            dose_rates_catheter[
1635                f"catheter_{catheter.name_id}_dwell_{dwell.name_id}"
1636                ] = dwell.dose_rate
1637        return dose_rates_catheter
