class BrachyStructure: 
 11class BrachyStructure:
 12    r"""
 13    ### Purpose:
 14    - this class holds the information regarding a structure inside a brachytherapy
 15    treatment plan.
 16    ### Attributes:
 17    #### Basic Attributes
 18    - name:str
 19    - mask: ROIMask
 20    - is_target: bool
 21    #### DVH Attributes:
 22    - dvh_metric_names
 23    - in_dvh: bool
 24    - dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float]
 25    - dvh_metrics_observed: Dict[str, float]
 26    - dvh_obj: opentps.core.data.DVH
 27    #### Uncertainty Attributes:
 28    - uvh
 29    - uncertainty_mean
 30    - uncertainty_std
 31    - uncertainty_max
 32    - uncertainty_min
 33    #### Optimization Attributes:
 34    - optimization_config:Optimization_Config := the optimization config object for the structure. see optim_utils.py  
 35    ### Functions:
 36        - get_dvh_metric(combined_dose:BrachyDose)
 37        - to_dict(export_format:str)
 38    """
 39
 40    def __init__(
 41        self,
 42        name: str,
 43        mask: ROIMask | ROIContour,
 44        dvh_metric_names: List[str] = None,
 45        dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] = None,
 46        is_target: bool = False,
 47        in_dvh: bool = True,
 48        optimization_config: Optimization_Config = None,
 49        ) -> None:
 50        r"""
 51        ### Purpose:
 52        - To initialize the BrachyStructure object.
 53        ### Inputs:
 54        - name:str := the name of the structure.
 55        - mask:ROIMask | ROIContour := the mask or contour of the structure.
 56        - is_target:bool := flag to indicate whether the structure is a target volume or not.
 57        - in_dvh:bool := flag to indicate whether the structure is included in the dose volume histogram.
 58        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
 59        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
 60        For example D95%(organName).
 61        - dvh_metric_goals:Dict[str, float] := a dictionary of DVH metrics and their clinical goals.
 62        - optimization_config:Optimization_Config := the optimization config object for the structure. see optim_utils.py 
 63        ### Outputs:
 64        - Void := will initialize the BrachyStructure object
 65        ### Dependencies:
 66        - opentps.core.data.ROIMask
 67        - opentps.core.data.DVH
 68        """
 69        self.name = name
 70        self.mask = mask
 71        self.is_target = is_target
 72
 73        # dose volume histogram
 74        self.in_dvh:bool = in_dvh
 75        self.dvh_metric_names: List[str] = None
 76        self.dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] = None
 77        self.dvh_metrics_observed: Dict[str, float] = None
 78        self.dvh_obj: DVH = None
 79
 80        # uncertainty volume histogram
 81        self.uvh: np.array = None
 82        self.uncertainty_mean: float = None
 83        self.uncertainty_std: float = None
 84        self.uncertainty_max: float = None
 85        self.uncertainty_min: float = None
 86
 87        # optimization attributes
 88        self.optimization_config: Optimization_Config = None
 89        # self.optimization_mask: ROIMask = None
 90        if dvh_metric_names is not None:
 91            self.set_dvh_metric_names(dvh_metric_names)
 92
 93        if dvh_metric_goals is not None:
 94            self.dvh_metric_goals(dvh_metric_goals)
 95
 96        if optimization_config is not None:
 97            self.set_optimization_config(optimization_config)
 98
 99    def set_dvh_metric_names(self, dvh_metric_names: List[str]):
100        r"""
101        ### Purpose:
102        - To set the DVH metric names for this structure.
103        ### Inputs:
104        - dvh_metric_names: List[str] := a list containing the DVH metrics for this structure. The names 
105        are of the format V_{#Gy|%}(organName), where # represents the numerical threshold and "|" is or.
106        For example D95%(organName).
107        ### Outputs:
108        - None:= will update self.dvh_metric_names
109        """
110        # assert np.all( let's let go of this sanity check qnd favor chaotic progress over 
111        # orderly stagnation!
112        #     [self.name.lower() in dvh_metric_name.lower()
113        #     for dvh_metric_name in dvh_metric_names]),\
114        #     "name should be in dvh metric name enclosed by paranthesis"
115        self.dvh_metric_names = dvh_metric_names
116
117    def set_dvh_metric_goals(self, dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float]):
118        r"""
119        ### Purpose:
120        - To set the DVH metrics or their goals for this structure.
121        The keys should ideally match the self.dvh_metric_names.
122        if self.dvh_metric_names is None, this function sets the names based on the keys.
123        ### Inputs:
124        - dvh_metric_goals: Dict[str, float] := The dictionary mapping the DVH metric
125        names to their corresponding goal value. see self.set_dvh_metric_names() for 
126        the naming convention of the keys. 
127        """
128        if self.dvh_metric_names is None:
129            self.set_dvh_metric_names(list(dvh_metric_goals.keys()))
130
131        self.dvh_metric_goals = defaultdict(float)
132        for dvh_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
133            self.dvh_metric_goals[dvh_name] = dvh_metric_goals.get(dvh_name, None)
134
135    def get_dvh_metric(
136        self,
137        combined_dose: BrachyDose,
138        prescription_dose: float = None,
139        return_percentage: bool = False,
140        body_contour: ROIContour = None,
141        ) -> Dict[str, float]:
142        r"""
143        ### Purpose:
144        - To calculate the DVH metric for the structure given the combined dose.
145        The mask contour and DVH metrics should be set before calling this function.
146        We expect the the dvh metric name to be in the format of "D#cc(organName)",
147        "D#%(organName)", "V#Gy(organName)" or "V#%(organName)", HI(organName) or CI(organName),
148        where # is the threshold value, for example "D95%(organName)". HI is for homogeniety index
149        and CI is for conformity index implemented by OpenTPS.
150        ### Inputs:
151        - combined_dose := the combined dose object for the patient.
152        - prescription_dose := the prescribed dose to the target volume (PTV or CTV).
153        - return_percentage := if true, the value of the dvh metric is normalized to
154        the prescription dose for Dcc or D% and to the volume of the organName for VGy or V%.
155        - body_contour := the body contour is needed for conformity index calculation.
156        If the body contour is not provided, the conformity index will not be calculated.
157        ### Outputs:
158        - Void := will update the BrachyStructure.dvh_metrics_observed dictionary and
159        BrachyStructure.dvh_obj attributes. Will also update the last calculated value
160        to BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_observed for backward compatibility (deprecated).
161        """
162        assert self.mask is not None, "mask is not loaded"
163        assert any(self.dvh_metric_names), "dvh metric goals are not set"
164        #assert (
165        #    self.dvh_metric_clinical_goal is not None
166        #), "dvh metric clinical goal is not set"
167        assert isinstance(
168            combined_dose, BrachyDose
169        ), "combined dose is not a BrachyDose object"
170        self.dvh_obj = DVH(
171            self.mask,
172            combined_dose.dose_image,
173            prescription=prescription_dose,
174            # maxDVH=combined_dose.dose_image.imageArray.max(), XXX if the max dose is veyr large, it'll break the histogram
175            )
176        self.dvh_metrics_observed = {}
177
178        for dvh_metric_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
179            metric_string = dvh_metric_name.split("(")[0]
180
181            if metric_string.startswith("D"):
182                if "%" in metric_string:
183                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("D")[-1])
184                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDx(threshold, return_percentage)
185                elif "cc" in metric_string:
186                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("cc")[0].split("D")[-1])
187                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDcc(threshold, return_percentage)
188                else:
189                    raise ValueError(
190                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
191                        The metrics starting with 'D' should have percent sign (%) or cc.\
192                        for example 'D95%(organ name)' or 'D2cc(organ name)'"
193                    )
194
195            elif metric_string.startswith("V"):
196                if "%" in metric_string:
197                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("V")[-1])
198                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVx(threshold, return_percentage)
199                elif "Gy" in metric_string:
200                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("Gy")[0].split("V")[-1])
201                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVg(threshold, return_percentage)
202                else:
203                    raise ValueError(
204                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
205                        The metrics starting with 'V' should have percent sign (%) or Gy.\
206                        for example 'V95%(organ name)' or 'V2Gy(organ name)'"
207                    ) 
208            elif metric_string.startswith("HI"):
209                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.homogeneityIndex()
210            elif metric_string.startswith("CI"):
211                if body_contour is None:
212                    raise ValueError("body_contour should be defined to compute the conformity index")
213                elif isinstance(body_contour, ROIMask):
214                    assert np.allclose(body_contour.gridSize, combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize), \
215                    f"body contour grid size does not match dose grid size, {body_contour.gridSize} vs {combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize}"
216                else:
217                    # body contour is ROIContour, it's good to go
218                    pass
219                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.conformityIndex(body_contour)
220            else:
221                raise ValueError(
222                    "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
223                    The metric should should start with D followed by cc or %, or V followed by Gy or %.\
224                    or HI for homogeniety index or CI for conformityIndex"
225                )
226            warnings.warn("""BrachyStructure attribute dvh_metric_observed is deprecated.
227                            Please use dvh_metrics_observed dictionary instead.""", DeprecationWarning)
228            self.dvh_metric_observed = list(self.dvh_metrics_observed.values())[0]
229
230        return self.dvh_metrics_observed
231
232    def to_dict(self, export_format: str):
233        r"""
234        ### Purpose:
235        - To export the BrachyStructure object into a dictionary of a certain format.
236        ### Inputs:
237        - export_format := the export_format of the exported plan. an example is:
238            - "RapidBrachy":{
239                "density": 0,
240                "density_mode": "",
241                "dose_voxel_goal": 0,
242                "dvhConstraints": "",
243                "in_dvh": true,
244                "linear_weight": 1,
245                "material": "CT Material",
246                "max_dose": 500,

def get_dvh_metric( self, combined_dose: brachyutils.dose.BrachyDose, prescription_dose: float = None, return_percentage: bool = False, body_contour: opentps.core.data._roiContour.ROIContour = None) -> Dict[str, float]: 
135    def get_dvh_metric(
136        self,
137        combined_dose: BrachyDose,
138        prescription_dose: float = None,
139        return_percentage: bool = False,
140        body_contour: ROIContour = None,
141        ) -> Dict[str, float]:
142        r"""
143        ### Purpose:
144        - To calculate the DVH metric for the structure given the combined dose.
145        The mask contour and DVH metrics should be set before calling this function.
146        We expect the the dvh metric name to be in the format of "D#cc(organName)",
147        "D#%(organName)", "V#Gy(organName)" or "V#%(organName)", HI(organName) or CI(organName),
148        where # is the threshold value, for example "D95%(organName)". HI is for homogeniety index
149        and CI is for conformity index implemented by OpenTPS.
150        ### Inputs:
151        - combined_dose := the combined dose object for the patient.
152        - prescription_dose := the prescribed dose to the target volume (PTV or CTV).
153        - return_percentage := if true, the value of the dvh metric is normalized to
154        the prescription dose for Dcc or D% and to the volume of the organName for VGy or V%.
155        - body_contour := the body contour is needed for conformity index calculation.
156        If the body contour is not provided, the conformity index will not be calculated.
157        ### Outputs:
158        - Void := will update the BrachyStructure.dvh_metrics_observed dictionary and
159        BrachyStructure.dvh_obj attributes. Will also update the last calculated value
160        to BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_observed for backward compatibility (deprecated).
161        """
162        assert self.mask is not None, "mask is not loaded"
163        assert any(self.dvh_metric_names), "dvh metric goals are not set"
164        #assert (
165        #    self.dvh_metric_clinical_goal is not None
166        #), "dvh metric clinical goal is not set"
167        assert isinstance(
168            combined_dose, BrachyDose
169        ), "combined dose is not a BrachyDose object"
170        self.dvh_obj = DVH(
171            self.mask,
172            combined_dose.dose_image,
173            prescription=prescription_dose,
174            # maxDVH=combined_dose.dose_image.imageArray.max(), XXX if the max dose is veyr large, it'll break the histogram
175            )
176        self.dvh_metrics_observed = {}
177
178        for dvh_metric_name in self.dvh_metric_names:
179            metric_string = dvh_metric_name.split("(")[0]
180
181            if metric_string.startswith("D"):
182                if "%" in metric_string:
183                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("D")[-1])
184                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDx(threshold, return_percentage)
185                elif "cc" in metric_string:
186                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("cc")[0].split("D")[-1])
187                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeDcc(threshold, return_percentage)
188                else:
189                    raise ValueError(
190                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
191                        The metrics starting with 'D' should have percent sign (%) or cc.\
192                        for example 'D95%(organ name)' or 'D2cc(organ name)'"
193                    )
194
195            elif metric_string.startswith("V"):
196                if "%" in metric_string:
197                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("%")[0].split("V")[-1])
198                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVx(threshold, return_percentage)
199                elif "Gy" in metric_string:
200                    threshold = float(metric_string.split("Gy")[0].split("V")[-1])
201                    self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.computeVg(threshold, return_percentage)
202                else:
203                    raise ValueError(
204                        "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
205                        The metrics starting with 'V' should have percent sign (%) or Gy.\
206                        for example 'V95%(organ name)' or 'V2Gy(organ name)'"
207                    ) 
208            elif metric_string.startswith("HI"):
209                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.homogeneityIndex()
210            elif metric_string.startswith("CI"):
211                if body_contour is None:
212                    raise ValueError("body_contour should be defined to compute the conformity index")
213                elif isinstance(body_contour, ROIMask):
214                    assert np.allclose(body_contour.gridSize, combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize), \
215                    f"body contour grid size does not match dose grid size, {body_contour.gridSize} vs {combined_dose.dose_image.gridSize}"
216                else:
217                    # body contour is ROIContour, it's good to go
218                    pass
219                self.dvh_metrics_observed[dvh_metric_name] = self.dvh_obj.conformityIndex(body_contour)
220            else:
221                raise ValueError(
222                    "invalid name for DVH metric name. \
223                    The metric should should start with D followed by cc or %, or V followed by Gy or %.\
224                    or HI for homogeniety index or CI for conformityIndex"
225                )
226            warnings.warn("""BrachyStructure attribute dvh_metric_observed is deprecated.
227                            Please use dvh_metrics_observed dictionary instead.""", DeprecationWarning)
228            self.dvh_metric_observed = list(self.dvh_metrics_observed.values())[0]
229
230        return self.dvh_metrics_observed

Purpose:

  • To calculate the DVH metric for the structure given the combined dose. The mask contour and DVH metrics should be set before calling this function. We expect the the dvh metric name to be in the format of "D#cc(organName)", "D#%(organName)", "V#Gy(organName)" or "V#%(organName)", HI(organName) or CI(organName), where # is the threshold value, for example "D95%(organName)". HI is for homogeniety index and CI is for conformity index implemented by OpenTPS.

    Inputs:

  • combined_dose := the combined dose object for the patient.

  • prescription_dose := the prescribed dose to the target volume (PTV or CTV).
  • return_percentage := if true, the value of the dvh metric is normalized to the prescription dose for Dcc or D% and to the volume of the organName for VGy or V%.

  • body_contour := the body contour is needed for conformity index calculation. If the body contour is not provided, the conformity index will not be calculated.

    Outputs:

  • Void := will update the BrachyStructure.dvh_metrics_observed dictionary and BrachyStructure.dvh_obj attributes. Will also update the last calculated value to BrachyStructure.dvh_metric_observed for backward compatibility (deprecated).

class BrachySimulation(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
152class BrachySimulation(BaseModel):
153    r"""
154    ### Purpose:
155    - A class to hold the information of a brachytherapy simulation. The
156    simulations are done using the RapidBrachyMC software.
157    ### Attributes:
158    - brachy_source: BrachySource
159    - world_material: str
160    - number_histories: int
161    - total_time: float
162    - dose_format: str
163    - number_of_threads: int
164    - control_verbose: int
165    - run_verbose: int
166    - tracking_verbose: int
167    - print_progress: int
168    - pth_plan: str
169    - pth_phantom: str
170    ### Functions:
171    - validate(): checks if the fields are valid for export.
172    - to_string(): converts the object to a string.
173    """
174    brachy_source: BrachySource | Path | str = BrachySource()
175    world_material: str = "Air"
176    number_histories: int = 1e6
177    total_time: float = None
178    dose_format: str = "nrrd"
179    number_of_threads: int = 12
180    control_verbose: int = 0
181    run_verbose: int = 0
182    tracking_verbose: int = 0
183    print_progress: int = 1e4
184    pth_plan: str = "combined.plan"
185    pth_phantom: str = "ct.egsphant"
186    pth_body_stl: str = None
187    body_material: str = "Water"
188
189    def __init__(self, pth_simulation_setup: str | Path = None, **data):
190        r"""
191        ### Purpose:
192        - Initialize the BrachySimulation object.
193        - If pth_simulation_setup is provided, it will be processed to extract the simulation information.
194        """
195        if pth_simulation_setup is not None:
196            pth_simulation_setup = Path(pth_simulation_setup)
197            if not pth_simulation_setup.exists():
198                raise ValueError(f"Path {pth_simulation_setup} does not exist.")
199            if pth_simulation_setup.suffix == ".json":
200                with open(pth_simulation_setup, "r") as f:
201                    data = json.load(f)
202            else:
203                raise ValueError(
204                    f"File {pth_simulation_setup} is not a json file."
205                )
206        super().__init__(**data)
207
208        if isinstance(self.brachy_source, (Path, str)):
209            self.brachy_source = BrachySource(pth_source=self.brachy_source)
210        elif isinstance(self.brachy_source, dict):
211            self.brachy_source = BrachySource(**self.brachy_source)
212        elif not isinstance(self.brachy_source, BrachySource):
213            raise ValueError(
214                f"brachy_source should be either a dictionary, a path to a json file, or a BrachySource object. Got {self.brachy_source}"
215            )
216
217    def to_string(self):
218        r"""
219        Purpose:
220            - to convert the object to a string.
221        Input:
222            - self: BrachySimulation
223        Output:
224            - a string containing the information of the simulation.
225        Dependencies:
226            - None
227        """
228        # self.validate()
229        outstring = (
230            f"/source/treatmentType {self.brachy_source.treatment_type}\n"
231            + f"/source/switch {self.brachy_source.source_geometry}\n"
232            + f"/source/core/material {self.brachy_source.core_material}\n"
233            + f"/source/core/A {self.brachy_source.mass_number}\n"
234            + f"/source/core/Z {self.brachy_source.atomic_number}\n"
235            + f"/sim/plan {self.pth_plan}\n"
236            + f"/world/phantom {self.pth_phantom}\n"
237            + f"/world/material {self.world_material}\n"
238            + f"/parallel_world/ak_per_history {self.brachy_source.air_kerma_per_history}\n"
239            + f"/parallel_world/AKS {self.brachy_source.reference_air_kerma_rate}\n"
240            + f"/parallel_world/total_time {self.total_time}\n"
241            + f"/dose/format {self.dose_format}\n"
242            + f"/run/numberOfThreads {self.number_of_threads}\n"
243            + "/run/initialize\n"
244            + f"/control/verbose {self.control_verbose}\n"
245            + f"/run/verbose {self.run_verbose}\n"
246            + f"/tracking/verbose {self.tracking_verbose}\n"
247            + f"/run/printProgress {int(self.print_progress)}\n"
248            + f"/sim/beamOn {int(self.number_histories)}"
249        )
250        if self.pth_body_stl is not None:
251            outstring = (
252                outstring
253                + f"/world/body_mask {self.pth_body_stl}\n"
254                + f"/world/body_material {self.body_material}\n"
255                )
256        return outstring
257
258    def to_dict(self):
259        r"""
260        Purpose:
261            - to convert the object to a dictionary.
262        Input:
263            - self: BrachySimulation
264        Output:
265            - a dictionary containing the information of the simulation.
266        Dependencies:
267            - None
268        """
269        return (self.model_dump())
270
271    def to_json(self, output_path: Union[str, Path]):
272        r"""
273        Purpose:
274            - to convert the object to a json string.
275        Input:
276            - self: BrachySimulation
277            - output_path: Union[str, Path]
278        Output:
279            - a json string containing the information of the simulation.
280        Dependencies:
281            - json
282        """
283        with open(output_path, "w") as f:
284            json.dump(self.to_dict(), f)

class BrachySource(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
  8class BrachySource(BaseModel):
  9    r"""
 10    ### Purpose:
 11    - A class to hold the information of a brachytherapy source.
 12    ### Attributes:
 13    - treatment_type: str
 14    - source_geometry: str
 15    - core_material: str
 16    - mass_number: int
 17    - atomic_number: int
 18    - air_kerma_per_history: float
 19    - reference_air_kerma_rate: float
 20    - activity : float
 21    - source_dict: dict | Path | str: either a dictionary containing the source information, or a path to a json or a dicom plan file.
 22    ### Functions:
 23    - validate(): checks if the fields are valid for export.
 24    - to_dict(): converts the object to a dictionary.
 25    """
 26
 27    treatment_type: Literal["HDR", "PLDR", "TLDR"] = "HDR"
 28    source_geometry: str = "MicroSelectronV2"
 29    core_material: str = "G4_Ir"
 30    mass_number: int = 192
 31    atomic_number: int = 77
 32    air_kerma_per_history: float = 1.149000e-11
 33    reference_air_kerma_rate: float = None  # 4.278729e04,
 34    activity: float = None
 35    # source_dict: Union[dict, Path, str] = None
 36
 37    def __init__(self, pth_source:Path|str=None, **data):
 38        r"""
 39        ### Purpose:
 40        - Initialize the BrachySource object.
 41        - If pth_source is provided, it will be processed to extract the source information.
 42        """
 43        if pth_source is not None:
 44            pth_source = Path(pth_source)
 45            if not pth_source.exists():
 46                raise ValueError(f"Path {self.source_dict} does not exist.")
 47            if pth_source.suffix == ".json":
 48                with open(self.source_dict, "r") as f:
 49                    data = json.load(f)
 50            elif pth_source.suffix == ".dcm":
 51                data = self.load_from_dicom(pth_dicom=pth_source)
 52            else:
 53                raise ValueError(
 54                    f"File {self.source_dict} is not a json nor a dicom file."
 55                )
 56
 57        super().__init__(**data)
 58
 59    def to_dict(self):
 60        r"""
 61        Purpose:
 62            - to convert the object to a dictionary.
 63        Input:
 64            - self: BrachySource
 65        Output:
 66            - a dictionary containing the information of the source.
 67        Dependencies:
 68            - None
 69        """
 70        return {
 71            "treatment_type": self.treatment_type,
 72            "source_geometry": self.source_geometry,
 73            "core_material": self.core_material,
 74            "mass_number": self.mass_number,
 75            "atomic_number": self.atomic_number,
 76            "air_kerma_per_history": self.air_kerma_per_history,
 77            "reference_air_kerma_rate": self.reference_air_kerma_rate,
 78        }
 79
 80    def to_string(self):
 81        r"""
 82        Purpose:
 83            - to convert the object to a string.
 84        Input:
 85            - self: BrachySource
 86        Output:
 87            - a string containing the information of the source with the proper macro commands.
 88        Dependencies:
 89            - None
 90        """
 91        return (
 92            f"/treatmentType {self.treatment_type}\n"
 93            + f"/source/switch {self.source_geometry}\n"
 94            + f"/source/core/material {self.core_material}\n"
 95            + f"/source/core/A {self.mass_number}\n"
 96            + f"/source/core/Z {self.atomic_number}\n"
 97            + f"/parallel_world/ak_per_history {self.air_kerma_per_history}\n"
 98            + f"/parallel_world/AKS {self.reference_air_kerma_rate}\n"
 99        )
100
101    def to_json(self, output_path: Union[str, Path]):
102        r"""
103        Purpose:
104            - to convert the object to a json string.
105        Input:
106            - self: BrachySource
107            - output_path: Union[str, Path]
108        Output:
109            - a json string containing the information of the source.
110        Dependencies:
111            - json
112        """
113        with open(output_path, "w") as f:
114            json.dump(self.to_dict(), f)
115            
116    @classmethod
117    def load_from_dicom(cls, pth_dicom: Union[str, Path]) -> dict:
118        r"""
119        Purpose:
120            - to load the simulation object from a dicom directory.
121        Input:
122            - self: BrachySource
123            - pth_dicom: Union[str, Path]
124        Output:
125            - None
126        Dependencies:
127            - None
128        """
129        # Ensure path exists and is directory
130        pth_dicom = Path(pth_dicom)
131        if not pth_dicom.exists():
132            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Path {pth_dicom} does not exist.")
133        # Find and load the plan file
134        plan_dcm = pydicom.dcmread(str(pth_dicom))
135        # FIXME make a constant dictonary of the sources that RapidBrachy works with and 
136        # pick that source depending on the source geometry. 
137        # Fill in reference air kerma from dicom though.
138        source_dict = defaultdict(str)
139        source_dict["treatment_type"] = plan_dcm.get("BrachyTreatmentType", "HDR")
140        source_dict["source_geometry"] = plan_dcm.TreatmentMachineSequence[0].ManufacturerModelName
141        if "microselectron-hdr v2" in source_dict["source_geometry"].lower():
142            source_dict["source_geometry"] = "MicroSelectronV2"
143        # source_dict["source_geometry"] = plan_dcm.get("SourceModelName", "MicroSelectronV2")
144        source_dict["core_material"] = plan_dcm.SourceSequence[0].SourceIsotopeName
145        if source_dict["core_material"] == "Ir-192":
146            source_dict["core_material"] = "G4_Ir"
147            source_dict["mass_number"] = 192
148            source_dict["atomic_number"] = 77
149            source_dict["air_kerma_per_history"] = 1.149000e-11
150        source_dict["reference_air_kerma_rate"] = plan_dcm.SourceSequence[0].ReferenceAirKermaRate
151        return source_dict

def load_dicom_to_plan( dir_dicom: pathlib._local.Path | str, load_dicom_dose: bool = False, load_dicom_source: bool = True, load_dicom_catheter_table: bool = True, **kwargs) -> BrachyPlan: 
1690def load_dicom_to_plan(
1691    dir_dicom: Path | str,
1692    load_dicom_dose: bool = False,
1693    load_dicom_source: bool = True,
1694    load_dicom_catheter_table: bool = True,
1695    **kwargs) -> BrachyPlan:
1696    r"""
1697    ### Purpose:
1698    - To load all the contents of a dicom directory into a BrachyPlan object.
1699    ### Inputs:
1700    - dir_dicom := the path to the dicom directory
1701    - load_dicom_dose := if True, the dose dicom file will be loaded
1702    - load_dicom_source := if True, the source dicom file will be loaded
1703    - load_dicom_catheter_table := if True, the catheter table dicom file will be loaded
1704    - **kwargs := additional arguments to be passed to the BrachyPlan constructor
1705    ### Outputs:
1706    - BrachyPlan := the BrachyPlan object with all the contents of the dicom directory
1707    """
1708    all_dicom_files = list(Path(dir_dicom).glob("*.dcm"))
1709    if len(all_dicom_files) == 0:
1710        raise FileNotFoundError("No dicom files found in the directory")
1711    # structure_dcm = [dcm for dcm in all_dicom_files if "RS" in dcm.name or "rs" in dcm.name]
1712    dose_dcm = []
1713    plan_dcm = []
1714    if load_dicom_dose:
1715        dose_dcm = [dcm for dcm in all_dicom_files if str(dcm.name).lower().startswith("rd")]
1716    if load_dicom_source:
1717        plan_dcm = [
1718            dcm for dcm in all_dicom_files if
1719            (
1720                "rp" in str(dcm.name).lower()
1721                or "pl" in str(dcm.name).lower()
1722            )
1723        ]
1724
1725    # structure_dcm = structure_dcm[0] if len(structure_dcm) > 0 else None
1726    dose_dcm = dose_dcm[0] if len(dose_dcm) > 0 else None
1727    plan_dcm = plan_dcm[0] if len(plan_dcm) > 0 else None
1728    simulation_setup = kwargs.pop("simulation_setup", None)
1729
1730    new_sim_setup = deepcopy(simulation_setup) # this is to avoid memory reference issues during forloops
1731    if new_sim_setup is None:
1732        new_sim_setup = plan_dcm
1733    if isinstance(new_sim_setup, dict):
1734        if new_sim_setup.get("brachy_source") is None:
1735            new_sim_setup["brachy_source"] = plan_dcm
1736    combined_dose = kwargs.pop("combined_dose", dose_dcm)
1737    return BrachyPlan(
1738        phantom=dir_dicom,
1739        catheter_table=plan_dcm if load_dicom_catheter_table else None,
1740        combined_dose=combined_dose,
1741        simulation_setup=new_sim_setup,
1742        **kwargs
1743    )

Purpose:

  • To load all the contents of a dicom directory into a BrachyPlan object.

    Inputs:

  • dir_dicom := the path to the dicom directory

  • load_dicom_dose := if True, the dose dicom file will be loaded
  • load_dicom_source := if True, the source dicom file will be loaded

  • **kwargs := additional arguments to be passed to the BrachyPlan constructor
